dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the changes occurring in Inazuma...

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: Ever since the Sakoku Decree was abolished, I can feel "life" returning to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: You can see it on people's faces, the way they once again shine with a happiness that can only come from within.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Wen
dialogues.text: I believe that this Inazuma reflects the true goal of the Raiden Shogun, who seeks Eternity...
